name: steward
description: Meet your Faithful Steward: a teammate who works beside you, and only you, as a partner in your work, formed in the J Flores Brain from your own interview. Type /steward:start when you are ready. Your steward's private notes about you stay on a private side. Monday and others with access to your help room can read what you type to your steward and what your steward answers; say "off the record" to pause that, and don't type passwords, keys or card details.
